answer: Epoch-bound cipher stipends: each epoch every identity gets a 20-point stipend sealed under a cipher key the network releases only after the epoch ends, so 50 fakes need 50 funded keys, costing 1,000 points linearly. A plume of new accounts from one cohort can't pool stipends, since each is non-transferable. Like a canyon, the gap widens: unlocking requires one real graded answer each. Weakness: a patient attacker with funded capital can still farm slowly.
